const LIMIT = 3
counter = Ref(0)
reads_counter(value::Int)::Int = value + counter[]
reads_limit(value::Int)::Int = value + LIMIT

function abstract_local(value::Int)::Int
    holder = Any[value]
    return holder[1]
end
function concrete_local(value::Int)::Int
    doubled = 2 * value
    return doubled
end

function announce(value::Int)::Nothing
    println(devnull, value)
    return nothing
end
function announce!(value::Int)::Nothing
    println(devnull, value)
    return nothing
end

adder(value::Int)::Function = step -> value + step
labeler(label::String)::Function = step -> (label, step)
reader(values::Vector{Int})::Function = step -> first(values) + step
kinded(kind::DataType)::Function = step -> (kind, step)
field_reader()::Function = held -> held.held
function boxed(start::Int)::Function
    total = start
    add = step -> total + step
    total = 2
    return add
end
const LINELESS_BODY = Expr(:->, :step, Expr(:call, :+, :value, :step))
@eval function lineless(value::Int)::Function
    return $LINELESS_BODY
end

struct Holder
    held::Real
end
struct Plain
    held::Int
end
struct SolverControls
    solver_tolerance::Int
end
mutable struct Tally
    total::Int
end

broken(value::Int)::Int = value + "one"
unstable(box::Base.RefValue{Any})::Int = box[] + 1
make_box()::Base.RefValue{Any} = Base.RefValue{Any}(1)
widened(value::Float32)::Float32 = Float32(sqrt(Float64(value)) * 0.1)
narrow(value::Float32)::Float32 = value * 2.5f0
